objective: Request a proposed demonstration of saving synthetic item A while preserving supplied timing and excluding the optional text-display segment from the capped agenda.
assumptions: The user and presenter are available.
R1 is mandatory; R2 is optional.
Screen recording is requested for any demonstrated requirement.

timed_script.live_action_request: Have the user save synthetic item A.
timed_script.observable_result: A screen showing item A in its saved state.

timed_script.live_action_request: Display the supplied text exactly as provided.
timed_script.observable_result: A screen displaying the supplied text.

evidence_requests.demo_evidence: Record the screen after item A is saved.
Record the screen only if the deferred segment is later demonstrated.

follow_up_questions.question: What later check, if any, should confirm that item A remains saved?
Should the optional text-display segment be scheduled outside the 5-minute cap?
